subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Manual vs. Automatic
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Manual vs. Automatic.

hook.text: A manual transmission puts the driver in control. An automatic does the thinking for you.

buildup.text: In a manual, you press the clutch, move the gear lever, and release—matching engine speed by feel.

discovery.text: Automatics use a torque converter—a fluid coupling that smoothly connects engine to gears.

twist.text: Manuals used to be more efficient, but modern automatics shift faster than any human can.

climax.text: Less than 1% of new US cars sold today are manual. They're disappearing from showrooms.

punchline.text: The stick shift is becoming a lost art.

quiz.question: What does a torque converter use to connect engine to gearbox?
